description: ECHO: Search EPA civil and criminal enforcement cases by state, ZIP code, regulatory program, case type, or filing-date range. Returns case identifier, case type and status, lead agency (EPA or state), primary law and section, enforcement outcome, federal and state penalties, cost recovery, compliance action and SEP costs, and filing, settlement, and closing dates. Case rows name no facility: pass a civil caseId to epa_echo_get_case for the facilities, defendants, and settlements behind it. Designed for area-level violation discovery — for a single known facility's enforcement history use epa_echo_get_facility instead. At least one of state or zip_code is required. Page past limit with offset and nextOffset.

case_type.description: Filter by case type: civil (regulatory violations), criminal (willful violations), or all. A filing-date range covers civil cases only: with a date, all returns civil cases and criminal is rejected.

date_filed_end.description: Latest filing date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Civil cases only. Omit, or pass "", for no upper bound.

date_filed_start.description: Earliest filing date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Civil cases only. Omit, or pass "", for no lower bound.

limit.description: Number of cases to return in one call. Default 25; a larger value returns at most 2,000 and says so. Page past it with offset and nextOffset.

offset.description: Number of cases to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's nextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

program.description: Filter by regulatory program: CAA=Clean Air Act, CWA=Clean Water Act, RCRA=hazardous waste, SDWA=drinking water, CERCLA=Superfund, EPCRA=emergency planning and community right-to-know (the statute behind TRI), FIFRA=pesticides, TSCA=toxic substances. Matches any law a case cites, so a returned case's programsViolated (its primary law) can differ.

state.description: 2-letter state or territory codes where the case is located (e.g. "TX", "PR"), case-insensitive, matching any of them. A case spanning several states matches each of them and is returned once. ECHO also files some cases under codes outside the USPS set; any 2-character code is searched as written.

zip_code.description: 5-digit ZIP codes of the case's facility locations, matching any of them; a ZIP+4 such as "98108-1234" searches its first five digits

name: epa_echo_search_violations

items.description: One case; caseStatus, enforcementOutcome, and the state/local penalty and cost fields are absent on criminal cases

caseId.description: Criminal ones start CR_; pass a civil one to epa_echo_get_case

complianceActionCostInDollars.description: Estimated cost of injunctive relief to return to compliance, in dollars

costRecoveryInDollars.description: Response costs agreed or ordered repaid (CERCLA), in dollars

enforcementOutcome.description: Resolution; absent when ECHO records none

filedDate.description: MM/DD/YYYY; the date the filing-date range bounds

primarySection.description: Section of the primary law; criminal cases cite the U.S. Code

effectiveQuery.description: The search as sent upstream, in input names: values, match modes, and result-changing defaults, "; "-joined.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_geographic_filter`: Neither state nor zip_code was given. `invalid_date`: A filing date is not a real calendar date. `date_range_inverted`: date_filed_start is after date_filed_end. `criminal_date_filter`: case_type "criminal" with a filing-date bound, which only civil cases carry. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitNotice.description: Present when a smaller limit than requested applied; says why.

message.description: Recovery hint on an empty page; absent otherwise.

nextOffset.description: Next offset; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Present when a filing-date range with case_type "all" dropped criminal cases, or when more cases follow (names the offset).

title: Search EPA Enforcement Cases
